Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 3. децембар ст. ст., „Свети пророк Софоније.“ — with «Свети» (not a rank, simply “saint”) and «пророк» (the `prophet` grade `types` keeps) left off, which leaves the bare forename as the whole of the form; the heading offers nothing else to distinguish him by. `sr-foldpred.mjs` measured the folded string at 0 other holders, so no READ_FOLDS key is owed.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (25 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 3 decembrie — «Sfântul Proroc Sofonie»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 3ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Προφήτης Σοφονίας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 3 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the page, and it is the same prophet, the ninth of the twelve minor prophets. Of the two Ἀπολυτίκια on its page the first, which names him, is taken here; the «Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον» is not drafted. The page differs from the folder's Romanian source about his tribe, saying «καταγόταν από τη φυλή του Συμεών ή κατ' άλλους του Λευΐ», of Simeon or by others of Levi, and that uncertainty is what the added paragraph records.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 16.12.2025 (3. децембар ст. ст.) — „Свети пророк Софоније.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, quoted whole with its closing full stop; URL year 2025 because that is the page `sr-civil.mjs` gave for a Julian day between 10-20 and 12-18 and therefore the page actually read. `types` UNTOUCHED: «пророк» is the `prophet` the folder already holds. `dates` UNTOUCHED and this is an AGREEMENT, not a silence — the book says «Живео и пророковао у VII веку пре Христа за време благочестивог цара јудејског Јосије», the seventh century before Christ under the devout king Josiah of Judah, which is exactly the interval and the reign saint.gr gave and the folder already carries. NO `locations`: «гора Саварата» is the mount the folder’s life already names off two other calendars and no coordinate was ever held. NO `related` row: the only other persons the entry names are the prophet Jeremiah, whom it calls his contemporary, and king Josiah, and sharing a generation is not a relation — the life is written without either name. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: A prorocului Tău, Doamne, Sofonie pomenire prăznuind, printr-însul Te rugăm, mântuieşte sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Proroc Sofonie; the common of a prophet, with his name set into it

english.text: Keeping the memory of your prophet Zephaniah, O Lord, through him we entreat you: save our souls.

hymns.text: Συνιείς φερωνύμως των μελλόντων την πρόγνωσιν, εκφαντορικώς προεκφαίνεις, την αιώνιον λύτρωσιν. Σιών γαρ βασιλέα τον Χριστόν, κηρύττεις Σοφονία εμφανώς· παρ' αυτού γαρ ελυτρώθημεν της αράς, Προφήτα οι βοώντες σοι· δόξα τω σε δοξάσαντι Θεώ, δόξα τω σε στεφανώσαντι, δόξα τω δωρουμένω διά σου, πάσι συγχώρησιν.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ήχος α', Της ερήμου πολίτης — the first of the two apolytikia on the page of «Προφήτης Σοφονίας», and it names him.

english.text: Understanding, as your name declares, the foreknowledge of things to come, you declare beforehand and openly the eternal redemption; for you plainly preach Christ as the king of Zion, Zephaniah, since by him we were redeemed from the curse, O prophet, we who cry to you: glory to God who glorified you, glory to him who crowned you, glory to him who gives pardon to all through you.

floruit.note: saint.gr: «Έζησε τον 7ο αιώνα π.Χ., επί βασιλέως Ιωσίου». The page gives no year.
